Area.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/8] Quite a few of the informants also pointed to how they, in the last days prior to the suicide, had noticed signs of desperation in the deceased. This was, in afterthought, interpreted as relating to how the young men, lacking strategies to handle difficulties in love and work, were entrapped and thus unable to move on in life.
